needed.suggestion: Add a clearly marked pedestrian crossing on the left side to provide a safe route for pedestrians.
Add a clearly marked pedestrian crossing on the right side to provide a safe route for pedestrians.
Install a marked pedestrian crossing to allow safe crossing of the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to allow wheelchair users and those with mobility aids to cross safely.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
